commits.message:
Add built-in presets support shipped with the repo

Built-in presets from src/data/built-in-presets.ts are merged with
localStorage user presets on load. Built-in presets cannot be deleted
from the UI. User presets with the same name override built-in ones.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Improve sidebar UX, add auto y-axis width, custom legend, and layout controls

- Collapse all sidebar sections by default except Layout
- Switch inputs to commit-on-blur/Enter instead of streaming keystrokes
- Add y-axis auto width that measures tick labels and aligns with title
- Replace Recharts Legend with custom HTML legend outside SVG for reliable
  positioning and margin controls (marginTop/marginBottom)
- Add configurable container padding, background color, and expose
  bottom margin in Layout section
- Fix reference-controls onValueChange → onChange bug
- Remove unused slider component

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Set default chart width to 920px and move responsive note to tooltip

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Change line-height to px units instead of unitless ratio

Title line-height defaults to 24px (was 1.3), subtitle to 18px (was
1.3). Input range updated to 8–72px with step 1. Rendered with px
suffix in inline styles.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Fix number inputs showing empty for undefined/NaN values

Add displayValue fallback in FigmaNumberInput to handle undefined/NaN
gracefully. Add placeholder support to number inputs. Use nullish
coalescing fallbacks for lineHeight and fontWeight in title controls
and rendering to handle state initialized before these properties
were added.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add line-height controls for chart title and subtitle

Configurable line-height (0.8–3.0, step 0.1) for both title and
subtitle, defaulting to 1.3. Rendered via inline lineHeight style.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Auto-enable title visibility when text is entered

Typing into the title or subtitle input automatically sets show=true
so users don't need to manually toggle the eye icon to see their text.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add font weight controls for chart title and subtitle

New FontWeight type (100-900) with dropdown selectors for both title
(default 600/Semi Bold) and subtitle (default 400/Regular). Renders
via inline fontWeight style on the title elements.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Fix chart container overflow when title is visible

Use flex column layout on the container so the title takes its natural
height (shrink-0) and the chart fills the remaining space (flex-1
min-h-0) instead of overflowing.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Fix title controls to use FigmaTextInput for consistent sidebar layout

Replace raw div/input with FigmaTextInput component matching the
pattern used by all other sidebar sections.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add chart title and subtitle support

New TitleConfig with text, subtitle, font size, color, and alignment
options. Title renders inside the chart container so it's included in
PNG/SVG exports. Sidebar controls use FigmaSection with eye toggle
for visibility. Disabled by default.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Fix SVG export by extracting native Recharts SVG with inlined styles

Use html-to-image for PNG (proven working) and native SVG extraction
for SVG export. Inlines all computed CSS properties (fill, stroke,
font, opacity) directly onto SVG elements so the exported file renders
correctly standalone. Adds background rect and strips class attributes.

Note: SVG export captures the chart vector content only (no HTML legend).
PNG export captures the full container including legend.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Switch chart export to html-to-image for reliable rendering

Replace manual SVG serialization with html-to-image library which
properly captures the full DOM element including CSS-styled content.
Fixes purple square issue caused by Recharts CSS classes not resolving
in standalone SVG.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Fix chart export rendering by inlining all computed SVG styles

Previous export produced a purple square because Recharts applies styles
via CSS classes that don't resolve in standalone SVG. Now inlines all
relevant computed styles (fill, stroke, font, opacity, etc.) on every
SVG element. Also adds container background color to PNG exports and
strips class attributes from the clone.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add chart export button with PNG and SVG support

Export button in top-left of playground with dropdown for PNG (2x scale)
and SVG formats. Uses native Recharts SVG element — no external deps.
PNG renders via canvas from serialized SVG, SVG inlines computed styles
for standalone use.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Fix TypeScript error in legend click handler type

Widen handleLegendClick parameter type to match Recharts LegendPayload
where dataKey can be string | number | function | undefined.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add combo charts, resize handles, legend toggle, custom tooltip, and horizontal bars

- Add combo chart type using Recharts ComposedChart (line + bar series together)
- Disable animations by default
- Add legend click to toggle series visibility (hide/unhide)
- Add colored square indicators to tooltip for series identification
- Support drag-to-resize on all four sides of the chart
- Add horizontal bar chart support (vertical layout with axis type overrides)
- Extract series controls into reusable LineSeriesSection, AreaSeriesSection, BarSeriesSection components

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Fix TypeScript errors for Vercel build

- Cast axis label position to LabelPosition type
- Use `as any` for polymorphic sample data return type
- Remove duplicate keys in tooltip constants
- Fix invalid labelPosition value in reference line default

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Initial commit: Recharts chart configurator playground

Interactive chart configuration tool with Figma-inspired dark UI.
Supports Line, Bar, Area, Pie, and Scatter charts with 300+ settings,
drag-to-resize panels, presets, and live code export.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
